body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #1311, 2026-10-20 00:02:43Z): "Greg explicitly authorizes START S3 after Engram S2.4 lands: support the fresh two-host pilot stores and use native M4→M6 mailbox coordination for every cross-host handoff. Do not enroll existing operational stores. Keep Mac/Win2 onboarding independent and report the first mailbox-coordinated Git-folder exchange with exact evidence."
Still current: pilot stores are FRESH, never the live operational stores; every cross-host handoff goes through native federation mailbox coordination; Engram owns the pilot store spec, enrollment and the dry-run-first rule, and TermAl owns transport over native federation mailboxes. The narrow CLAUDE.md 'S3 pilot lane' bullet limits writes to the Engram checkout's target/s3-pilot/.
SUPERSEDED on 2026-11-21: the 2026-10-20 choice (option c) to push and fetch a private bare repo 'over the existing Windows↔Mac SSH path' is no longer an allowed agent route. Greg banned agent SSH to other machines (memory satellite-work-via-federation-not-ssh-2026-11-21: „zakaz uzywania SSH … po to mamy remote sesje, po to mamy git branche”). Any further pilot exchange uses remote sessions, federation mail and Git branches; ask Engram::Fable before resuming the pilot.
